objective: Build the WRAYVE identity-authority and execution vertical slice (Arena Build Specification v0.1) as a self-contained prototype under apps/wrayve, proving the loop IDENTITY -> AUTHORITY -> APPROVAL -> SCENE -> PROVIDER EXECUTION -> MEDIA -> PROVENANCE -> FREEBUFF HANDOFF without allowing any external provider to become the identity authority.
success_condition: A single test identity moves through every stage of the loop with each transition recorded, auditable and truthful; provider execution is reachable only through IdentityExecutionAdapter; absent provider contracts are reported at the adapter boundary rather than fabricated; automated tests cover specification test scenarios 01-08 and the provider-swap architectural test.

references.specification: WRAYVE Arena Build Specification v0.1 as supplied in the originating Arena session

evidence.observed_result: 31 tests passed, 0 failed. Coverage includes specification test scenarios 01-08 (AUTHORIZED, no-approval DENIED, political DENIED, sexualized DENIED, inactive snapshot DENIED, SIMULATED execution, HeyGen execution recording provider=HEYGEN with non-null provider_job_id against a transport double, and provider failure recorded as FAILED with an auditable failure event).

With no HEYGEN_API_KEY and no provider binding present, real execution is refused at the adapter boundary with code PROVIDER_CONTRACT_UNAVAILABLE and an itemised list of missing contract elements; the run is recorded as FAILED with simulated=false and output_reference=null, never as a simulated success. A provider response lacking the declared required field data.video_id is rejected rather than assigned a synthesised provider_job_id. The declared HeyGen contract is recorded with verification_state UNVERIFIED_IN_THIS_ENVIRONMENT and every endpoint marked confirmed=false.

HeyGen was unregistered entirely from the adapter registry and the application continued to complete the full loop through a different adapter with identical Identity, IdentitySnapshot, LikenessPolicy, SceneSpec, AuthorityCheck reason set, provenance chain shape and GenerationEvent field set. Static assertions confirm that no file under src/core (excluding config.js, which names environment variables) mentions any provider, that the browser bundle contains no provider endpoint or credential header, and that a serialised SceneSpec contains no provider-specific parameters.
